$comment: RP6 thumbnail start frame (D366, user 2026-11-12: 'for each reel, there needs be a start frame which will need to act as the thumbnail, just 1 frame, this should be edited in a way to showcase what's the reel is about'). Read by services/clip/reel_thumbnail.py. One frame at the very start of a montage, match reel, impact-play reel or live clip (V canvas): the reel's strongest moment as the picture, a short title from the reel's own facts (game text read by the detectors, kill count, result, mode; never chat), the streamer brand from data/profile.local.json (never committed). Also kept as thumbnail.png in the reel's folder; posting uses the first frame as the cover. Made locally with ffmpeg and the bundled fonts (data/fonts), no model. Behind the flag reel-thumbnail (off by default). Sizes are fractions of the frame height; positions stay inside the targets' safe area.
approved: user 2026-11-12 chose the feature (one edited start frame per reel, made locally); the look, sizes and title wording are the agent's proposal (plan RP6)

moment.why: The frame is taken just after the strongest medal appears (its card is then on screen), else just after the densest run of kills; windowSec is the same 3 s as the payoff-first hook (data/clip/reel-hook.json).

picture.why: ffmpeg hue (s = saturation, b = brightness on its -10..10 scale) and unsharp (luma amount), both in the LGPL ffmpeg builds; a little more colour, a little darker so the white title reads, a light sharpen, a soft vignette.

text.$comment: Per reel type, the first template whose fields are all known is used. Fields: {medal} the strongest medal's name, {killsText} the own kill count (1 KILL, 3 KILLS), {result} the match result, {mode} MP or BR. A sub line equal to the main line is left out.
